rawText: Issue UAE Certificates of Conformity for Products Subject to Technical Regulations​ Start Service About this service This service allows you to apply for a UAE Certificate of Conformity for products subject to technical regulations (as outlined by regulatory decisions issued by the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology), confirming that the products comply with the approved standard specifications in the country. This facilitates and streamlines the process of product entry and circulation in the country’s markets. 1 Service Procedure Registration in the digital platform of MOIAT Login or Register to the Ministry services digital platform Apply to “Issuing conformity certificates for products according to health and safety requirements” Attach the required documents Payment of fees 2 Requirements A valid trade license A test report on the product issued by an accredited laboratory 3 Documents GMark User Manual File Name : GMark User Manual File Size : 920 KB Filter Type : application/pdf Quality Documents File Name : QualityDocuments File Size : 9617 KB Filter Type : application/x-zip-compressed Application Form File Name : Issue Conformity Certificates - ECAS File Size : 223 KB Filter Type : application/pdf Vehicle Workshop User Manual File Name : Vehicle Workshop User Manual File Size : 550 KB Filter Type : application/pdf User Manual File Name : ECAS User Manual File Size : 642 KB Filter Type : application/pdf List of technical requirements for regulated products File Name : CAD Regulated Sheet File Size : 262 KB Filter Type : application/pdf Service Fees Carrying out the technical evaluation of the establishments for their registration in the UAE Conformity Assessment System: 2500 dirhams per working day / technical assessor. (in case the technical evaluation was conducted) 600 dirhams Submitting a request to register products and services in the UAE Conformity Assessment System 620 dirhams Technical review of documents for each conformity certificate 500 dirhams Issuance of conformity certificate from the Ministry AED 2500 One working day/technical assessor (if a technical assessment is conducted)​ Conducting a technical assessment of establishments for registration in the UAE Conformity Assessment System Please select service 0 AED Note: In addition, the entity shall bear all the costs and expenses incurred in amending the accreditation activity, in addition to the expenses of travel, transportation, the residence of the assessor, or any additional expenses Service Time One and a half Working Days Package N/A Quick Links National Customer Relation Management - NCRM Refund for Service fees and Transactions FAQs How can I obtain a conformity certificate for my product?
